test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(**Note :** The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: ​

Option (1): PSU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e026f629681450fcf51159d4831220205d4e3b161b27b5059604475d125694b.png] 

Option (2): HKN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/432ebda5b34d5fa98a2022a242d2d7b7ffd040cf59d92af45a2ee41e2aee6c24.png] 

Option (3): DGJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb275cccdc168bb4ce8c8a1b67b1da6c158ae62d687647f05fbde52decf6dcb7.png] 

Option (4): TWZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6b66fa8c5fdcf56741b86e6c160f96732cfdcad5d07e9298fe42679085262c2.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "PSU" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
